operation.summary: Register this Bridgit's two names in one step on the first control call (Device Domain Name + friendly name), or change its friendly name, label or visibility; the domain name is kept for good; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: name
body.description: Required when unregistered: 3-30 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, about 10 characters, cute and friendly (kitchen-tab); first come, first served

body.name: friendly_name
body.description: Required when registering (unless the owner already named this phone): up to 40 characters, any style, unique among the owner's devices; displayed nearly everywhere, never public. Also changes it later

body.name: label
body.description: Up to 60 characters shown on public lookup; null clears

body.name: visible
body.description: Public lookup shows label and online; default true; false hides

operation.returns: status,name,friendly_name,needs_friendly_name,label,visible; 409 name_taken (lookup) means suggest another domain name; 409 friendly_name_taken (held_by) means another friendly name; 409 already_named means the name is fixed

friendly_name.description: Required when registering (unless the owner already named this phone): up to 40 characters, any style, unique among the owner's devices; displayed nearly everywhere, never public. Also changes it later

visible.description: Public lookup shows label and online; default true; false hides

name.description: Required when unregistered: 3-30 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, about 10 characters, cute and friendly (kitchen-tab); first come, first served

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

label.description: Up to 60 characters shown on public lookup; null clears
